In [129]:
# I cannot figure out how to import my modules so I am just pasting the functions I need here
def describe(a):

    '''
    --------input-------
    a = np.array

    -------output----------

    The describe function [prints descriptions of the array a
    
    '''
    
    
    print(f"length is {len(a)}")
    print(f"size is {a.size}")
    print(f"shape is {a.shape}")
    print(f"number of dimensions is {a.ndim}")
    print(f"contents are...\n{a}")
    print(f"maximum value is {a.max()}")
    print(f"minimum value is {a.min()}")

count = 1
for image in [img1, img2]:
 
    # imshow each image
    plt.imshow(np.log(image), cmap='gray')
    # add a colorbar for each image
    plt.colorbar()
    # adds a title for each image, I'm using a counter variable to know which image I am pritning to add the appriopriuate title 
    if count == 1:
        plt.title("img 1")
    elif count == 2:
        plt.title("img 2")
    # actually draw the imshow for each image
    plt.show();
    
    print(count)
    count += 1 # counter variable for the title of the images
